events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate poll card, event-setup, zoom-pro exports
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n "polls\|Polls" app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts | head -30; grep -n "event-setup\|eventSetup\|scheduleWeekly\|nextRuns\|upcoming" cloud/src/jobs-day2.ts | head -30; grep -n "^export\|polls" cloud/src/zoom-pro.ts | head -40

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read Zoom section of eventSetup
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -n 444,512p cloud/src/jobs-day2.ts; grep -n "export async function zoomEnsure\|export async function zoomToken\|export async function track\|class VendorError\|export function zh\b\|const zh" -r cloud/src | head

events.text: Reading the Zoom helpers in build.ts so I can add poll creation next to meeting creation.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find go/req helpers, simulator, probe
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n "^async function go\|^export async function go\|^async function req\|^export async function req\|function go<\|function req<" cloud/src/connectors/*.ts | head; ls cloud/scripts | grep -i sim; grep -rn "zoom" --include=vendor-sim.py -l . 2>/dev/null | head -3; wc -l cloud/scripts/probe-t268.mjs

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read go/req, probe, sim zoom routes
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -n 15,60p cloud/src/connectors/build.ts; cat cloud/scripts/probe-t268.mjs; grep -n "zoom" cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head -40

events.text: Now checking the simulator's Zoom routes, then I'll add poll creation.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read sim poll route and existing callers
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -n 517p cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | cut -c150-400; sed -n 1240,1258p cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py; grep -rn "/polls" cloud/src --include=*.ts | grep -v report | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find existing poll creation code
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -rn "/polls\`\|polls\`" cloud/src | grep -v report | cut -c1-220 | head; grep -n "polls" cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | cut -c1-160 | head; grep -rn "no_poll_scope\|zoom_flags" cloud/scripts/*.mjs | cut -c1-160 | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read zoom-control poll creation
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -n 185,240p cloud/src/zoom-control.ts; grep -rn "zoom_flags\|no_poll_scope" cloud/scripts/ --include=*.mjs | cut -c1-200 | head -4
